INSERT INTO ICOMCART( BUYER ,USER_ID ,CONTRACT_NO ,CONTRACT_SEQ ,USE_FLAG ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,SEQ ,AGENT ,CART_QTY ,BYIT_COMORG_CODE ,REF_PR_NO ,BUDGET_DEPT ,ACCOUNT_TYPE ,UNIT_PRICE ,CREATE_DATE ,REG_DATE ,SIZE_QTY ,SIZE_LEN ) SELECT A.BUYER ,A.USER_ID ,C.CONTRACT_NO ,C.CONTRACT_SEQ ,A.USE_FLAG ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,(SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ),NULL,'0', MAX(SEQ))+1 FROM ICOMCART WHERE BUYER = #{buyer} AND USER_ID = #{userid} AND USE_FLAG = 'C' ) AS SEQ ,CASE WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'Y' then C.AGENT WHEN (SELECT NVL(AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'N') FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER) = 'N' then 'KRKORE0001' ELSE 'N/A' END AS AGENT --공급사 ,TO_NUMBER(A.CART_QTY) AS CART_QTY ,A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE
,( SELECT A.CODE||'^'||A.TEXT1||'^'||B.CODE1||'^'||B.TEXT1||'^'||B.CODE2||'^'||B.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 A, ICOMCOD3 B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TYPE = 'C020' AND B.TYPE = 'SPOT' AND B.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.COMPANY_CODE = #{buyer} AND A.CODE||'^'||TRIM(B.CODE1)||TRIM(B.CODE2) = TRIM(A.REF_PR_NO) ) AS REF_PR_NO ,'' AS BUDGET_DEPT --BUDGET_DEPT ,'' AS ACCOUNT_TYPE --ACCOUNT_TYPE
,A.REF_PR_NO ,A.BUDGET_DEPT ,A.ACCOUNT_TYPE
,'' AS REF_PR_NO ,'' AS BUDGET_DEPT --BUDGET_DEPT ,'' AS ACCOUNT_TYPE --ACCOUNT_TYPE
,C.TARGET_PRICE ,SYSDATE ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ,TO_NUMBER(A.SIZE_QTY) AS SIZE_QTY ,TO_NUMBER(A.SIZE_LEN) AS SIZE_LEN FROM ICOMCART_TMP A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = #{buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{userid} AND A.SEQ = #{SEQ} AND NVL(A.USE_FLAG,' ') = 'C' AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND NVL(B.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(C.STATUS,' ') <> 'D' AND NVL(A.REMARK,' ') = ' ' --Validation Error가 없는건 AND C.BELOW_COMORG_CODE = DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BELOW_COMORG_CODE =A.BUYER AND STATUS ^= 'D'),0,'ABOVE',A.BUYER)
